title: Mud Island
html_source: Ballybough is an inner city district of north east Dublin city, Ireland. The term Bailebough in Irish is derived from the ‘Baile’ Town and ‘Bocht’ meaning ‘poor’. Prior to its urbanization in the late nineteenth century, Ballybough was known as Mud Island, owing to its proximity to the mud flats that now form Fairview and environs. In 2013, Dublin City Councillor Nial Ring started a controversial campaign to change the official Irish name from Baile Bocht to Baile Bog, on the grounds that ‘Poor Town’ was insulting to the residents.
